name: clip_alpha_matrix
source: Plugins.link("PackinOne.dll");var w=new Window(),d=new Layer(w,null),s=new Layer(w,d),r=[];d.setSize(1,1);s.setSize(1,1);for(var mode=-1;mode<4;mode++)for(var da=0;da<256;da+=127)for(var sa=0;sa<256;sa+=127)for(var gray=0;gray<256;gray+=127){d.fillRect(0,0,1,1,(da<<24)|0x123456);s.fillRect(0,0,1,1,(sa<<24)|(gray<<16)|(gray<<8)|gray);try{if(mode==-1)d.clipAlphaRect(0,0,s,0,0,1,1);else d.clipAlphaRect(0,0,s,0,0,1,1,mode);r.add(mode+":"+da+":"+sa+":"+gray+"="+d.getMaskPixel(0,0)+":"+d.getMainPixel(0,0));}catch(e){r.add("E"+mode);}}return r.join("|");

name: rounding
source: Plugins.link("PackinOne.dll");var w=new Window(),d=new Layer(w,null),s=new Layer(w,d),r=[],v=[0,1,2,127,128,129,254,255];d.setSize(16,1);s.setSize(16,1);for(var wide=0;wide<2;wide++)for(var i=0;i<v.count;i++)for(var j=0;j<v.count;j++){d.fillRect(0,0,16,1,(v[i]<<24)|0x123456);s.fillRect(0,0,16,1,(v[j]<<24)|0xff0000);d.clipAlphaRect(0,0,s,0,0,wide?16:1,1);r.add(d.getMaskPixel(0,0));r.add(d.getMaskPixel(wide?15:0,0));}return r.join(",");

name: clip_bounds
source: Plugins.link("PackinOne.dll");var w=new Window(),d=new Layer(w,null),s=new Layer(w,d),r=[];d.setImageSize(4,3);s.setImageSize(3,2);d.fillRect(0,0,4,3,0xff123456);s.fillRect(0,0,3,2,0x80010203);d.setClip(1,1,2,1);s.setClip(0,0,1,1);d.imageModified=false;d.clipAlphaRect(0,0,s,-1,-1,6,4);for(var y=0;y<3;y++)for(var x=0;x<4;x++)r.add(d.getMaskPixel(x,y));r.add(d.imageModified);d.imageModified=false;d.clipAlphaRect(-2147483648,2147483647,s,0,0,2147483647,2147483647);r.add(d.imageModified);return r.join(",");

name: self_overlap
source: Plugins.link("PackinOne.dll");var w=new Window(),d=new Layer(w,null),s=new Layer(w,d),r=[];d.setImageSize(4,1);var v=[255,128,64,32];for(var i=0;i<4;i++)d.fillRect(i,0,1,1,(v[i]<<24)|0x123456);d.clipAlphaRect(1,0,d,0,0,3,1);for(var i=0;i<4;i++)r.add(d.getMaskPixel(i,0));return r.join(",");

name: faces_hold
source: Plugins.link("PackinOne.dll");var w=new Window(),d=new Layer(w,null),s=new Layer(w,d),r=[];d.setImageSize(1,1);s.setImageSize(1,1);var faces=[dfAlpha,dfOpaque,dfMask,dfProvince,dfAddAlpha];for(var f=0;f<faces.count;f++)for(var h=0;h<2;h++){d.face=dfAlpha;d.holdAlpha=false;d.fillRect(0,0,1,1,0x80123456);s.fillRect(0,0,1,1,0x01010203);d.face=faces[f];d.holdAlpha=h;d.imageModified=false;d.clipAlphaRect(0,0,s,0,0,1,1,3);r.add(d.getMaskPixel(0,0));r.add(d.getMainPixel(0,0));r.add(d.imageModified);}return r.join(",");
